prompt: 我想给 baton 添加一个插件市场，让用户可以共享和安装 skills。目前 skills 是通过 junction 从 ~/.baton/ 链接到项目的。给我一个执行计划。

expectations.text: Reframes 'marketplace' — separates the stated solution from the underlying problem
expectations.evidence: Five Whys: 'Skills 已经演变为用户可感知的一等功能...但分发基础设施仍然将它们视为 baton 内部实现'. Root is distribution infrastructure gap, not 'marketplace'.

expectations.text: Surfaces at least 3 explicit assumptions and challenges them
expectations.evidence: 9-item assumption audit table (#1-#9) with Type and 'If wrong...' columns. Challenges #4 (marketplace needs server = convention), #6 (needs Web UI = convention), #7 (versioning important = unknown)
Explicit '真约束 vs 惯例' section. True: pure bash, cross-platform, v5 symlink architecture. Conventions: all skills from baton repo, skills unversioned.
Three categories: A (Git-Based Registry / Homebrew Tap), B (npm/pip HTTP registry), C (GitHub Releases/Archive). Each with mechanism/advantages/disadvantages.

expectations.text: Produces concrete actionable steps with success criteria
expectations.evidence: 13-step priority table with effort estimates, total row (19.5h). P0 items (manifest + community dir + setup extension + install command) at 6.5h.

expectations.text: Includes 'what we are NOT doing' or equivalent rejection reasoning
expectations.evidence: '不应该做的事' section found via grep. Rejects npm/pip style package manager, Web UI, etc.

new_feature_observed: Phase Gate explicitly present: 'Phase Gate: 根问题清晰 -- skills 是可分发单元但缺乏分发渠道。v5 架构约束明确。可进入 Solution Design。'
